verdict.rationale: LM Studio's docs explicitly state you can connect/install MCP servers and use them with local models, and community reports (HN) confirm users actually tried MCP integration in LM Studio, giving real-world corroboration beyond marketing. However the hands-on account describes a rough initial experience (infinite loop, unclear model download steps), so it's not flawless. Missing for 10: broader independent confirmation of stable MCP tool-use across multiple servers, and detailed first-party MCP setup/config documentation.
